### LoopCommandInput

```ts
const LoopCommandInput: Union<
  readonly [
    Struct<{
      action: Literal<"start">;
      text: String;
      requestId: String;
    }>,
    Struct<{
      action: Literals<
        readonly ["status", "pause", "resume", "stop", "stop-ask", "new"]
      >;
      confirmed: optional<Boolean>;
    }>,
    Struct<{}>,
  ]
>;
```

Arguments of the human `/loop` command. `start` carries the typed text:
`<prompt>` paces itself, `<N>m <prompt>` or `<N>h <prompt>` runs on an interval.
A bare call opens the controls.
